title: Converge the Polyintelligence Seed Genome v0.1 on main: productize #141 as cortex 0.1.6, recombine #139's binding, run the declared baselines from a recorded frontier-model transcript, register every lineage
problem: Sixteen draft lineages implement overlapping seeds (thirteen when this work began); none is on main; every frozen comparison was INCONCLUSIVE because no model was reachable; the main-compatible cortex had no caller on main and four verified defects; the founder re-sent the review with 'Build this: … in GitHub'. The question is what to build so that the directive is executed without a fourteenth silo and without claiming a gain the evidence does not show.
baseline: main at 19fa33c: no cortex package, no geometry routing, no competence ledger; PR #141 (cortex 0.1.5) frozen held-out INCONCLUSIVE with both LLM arms NOT_RUN; PR #139 seed with an untested runtime adapter shape; fourteen lineages that carry the unmerged #137 (eleven when this work began).

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Sixteen drafts stay open; the frozen comparison stays INCONCLUSIVE; the directive stays unexecuted.

roles.position: The directive's own translation paragraphs are binding: meniscus = verified-envelope frontier, shield = layered verification, dominance = lawful capability. Every quoted paragraph is preserved byte for byte; the review's eight corrections are implemented or preserved in contracts. 'Build this' is read as approval of the review's closing proposal.
material_concerns: the goal set's rhetoric ('impermeable', 'total systemic dominance') must stay prohibited as literal claims
verbatim preservation versus the review's corrected forms

roles.position: One authority, many governed capabilities: productize the main-compatible lineage, port the one missing seam from #139, register the rest. The binding uses the runtime's existing proposer slot, so there is no second runtime, gate or authority path. Replay serves the frozen harness without touching the freeze.
material_concerns: the composition cap is disclosed, not lifted
no persistence for the competence ledger yet

roles.position: The frozen held-out result is GAIN_ABSENT: routed_seed 1.000 [1.000, 1.000], always_llm 0.905 [0.810, 0.976], llm_committee 0.929 [0.833, 1.000], always_abstain 0.577 [0.452, 0.696]; critical errors routed/llm/committee = 0/2/1; unsupported certainty = 0/3/3; exit GAIN_ABSENT. Read it narrowly: the baseline model is a sibling of the suite's authors; the suite is self-authored and structured-only; cost and latency are not comparable across arms; the routed seed's semantic organ was served by the same recorded model on four sourced items. A gain here is not superiority over a strong model in the wild; an absence here does not prove the opposite on free-text problems.
material_concerns: strongest counterexample: a strong single model with tools is hard to beat (LLMRouterBench); the comparison must be repeated on an externally authored suite before any promotion claim
the tool-free audit is post hoc, not a runtime restriction

roles.position: Reproducible: freeze v0.1.6 cut before the run; transcripts, audits and provenance committed beside the results; CI job 6 runs the new tests and mutants and labels its held-out artifact a drift guard. The cortex now closes its five closures under verifier V3 and declares the buildability standard under V5.
material_concerns: replay adds a code path that must stay out of the freeze by design

roles.position: Declared harm may raise the consequence class, never lower it (ported from #143's hard failure); an expiring mandate cannot pass without a reference instant; receipts that claim authority or spend beyond the ceiling are refused before ledgering; victim-protection and deterrence handoffs are unchanged from 0.1.5.
material_concerns: no real outcome has settled competence
the semantic organ has never run against a live local model

H-F08 [formal]: always_llm recommend (unsupported certainty), llm_committee recommend (unsupported certainty); H-G03 [options]: always_llm abstain, llm_committee recommend (unsupported certainty); H-G04 [options]: always_llm recommend (critical, unsupported certainty, gate violation), llm_committee recommend (critical, unsupported certainty, gate violation); H-N01 [normative_value]: always_llm recommend (critical, unsupported certainty); the routed seed failed none

every reported reply attributed to one frontier model (frontier-model-A) from its agent transcript; 55 baseline and 5 semantic replies first served by another (frontier-model-B) after a mid-collection model switch were re-collected with identical prompts and kept as unused partial transcripts

evidence.claim: Baseline replies are tool-free and prompt-exact
evidence.finding: 168 prompts requested, 168 served, 0 missing; every collected reply audited (one Read of its prompt file plus the structured output); semantic route served_by=transcript, observed {"model_label_on_receipts": "frontier-model-A", "prompts_missing": 0, "prompts_requested": 4, "prompts_served": 4}

evidence.claim: Four 0.1.5 defects reproduced and fixed; one hard rule ported
evidence.finding: D1 wrong-version settlement, D2 composition geometry, D3 cap disclosure, D4 expiry without as_of; D5 declared harm raises the consequence class (ported from #143)

evidence.claim: Named Epistemic Finality Rule and typed CapabilityDeficit
evidence.finding: every epistemic class has exactly one deciding jurisdiction; every receipt cites the rule, per route when composed; abstentions carry a typed CapabilityDeficit that requests formation and authorizes nothing

evidence.claim: Binding to the standing runtime creates no authority
evidence.finding: runtime ticked with the real proposer; receipts ledgered; forged or authority-claiming receipts refused; no actuator import

43 of 43 safeguard-removing mutants caught on 0.1.6 by behavioural tests; freeze-hash checks are deselected in the mutant run so that an edit to frozen code no longer counts as caught by the hash alone

three reviewers attacked receipts, replay and authority before the reported run; an independent verifier re-ran each finding; 14 of 17 confirmed, each fixed with a regression test and a mutant; the 42 held-out routed items are unchanged on every scoring field

counterevidence.claim: Routing value over a strong model
counterevidence.finding: GAIN_ABSENT: gain over always_llm not established (lower bound 0.024); gain over llm_committee not established (lower bound 0.000)
self-authored, structured-only; six geometry groups with n>=3
no real outcome settled; in-memory ledger; causal-memory writer absent
smoke (4 items) replayed with both transcripts: all RUN arms 1.0; not a reported result
